models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.description: First model of the Claude 5.5 family with a 1M context window, always-on adaptive thinking, and lower pricing than Opus 5

changelog.description: Claude Opus 5.5 released with a 1M context window, up to 128K output tokens, always-on adaptive thinking, and a June 2026 knowledge cutoff
Pricing set at $4.00 per 1M input tokens and $20.00 per 1M output tokens, 20% below Opus 5; cache reads drop to $0.20 per 1M tokens

Breaking changes from Opus 5: thinking can no longer be disabled, forced tool use returns an error, thinking blocks are bound to the model and conversation, and the computer_20251124 tool was removed; default effort changed from high to medium
Anthropic announced Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 will follow in the coming weeks

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.description: Anthropic's most capable generally available model, a Mythos-class model with safeguards for the most demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work

changelog.description: Claude Fable 5.1 released alongside the restricted-access Claude Mythos 5.1, with a 1M context window, 128K max output, always-on adaptive thinking, and a June 2026 knowledge cutoff
Pricing unchanged from Fable 5 at $10.00 per 1M input tokens and $50.00 per 1M output tokens; cache reads cut 75% from $1.00 to $0.25 per 1M tokens
Forced tool use behavior changed (breaking change); Anthropic recommends starting workloads on Opus and escalating to Fable 5.1

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.description: Claude 5 generation Opus model with a 1M context window, adaptive thinking, and Fast Mode; superseded by Opus 5.5

changelog.description: Claude Opus 5 released as the successor to Opus 4.8 with a 1M context window, adaptive thinking with low/medium/high/xhigh/max effort, and Fast Mode output about 2.5x faster
Pricing set at $5.00 per 1M input tokens and $25.00 per 1M output tokens; cached input $0.50 per 1M tokens
Claude Opus 5 replaced Opus 4.8 as the default model on the Claude Max plan
Moved to the legacy model list after the release of Claude Opus 5.5; remains available for compatibility and migration comparisons

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.description: Claude 5 generation Sonnet model with a 1M context window and near-Opus coding performance at Sonnet pricing

changelog.description: Claude Sonnet 5 released with a 1M context window, 128K max output, adaptive thinking, and a January 2026 knowledge cutoff
Introductory pricing set at $2.00 per 1M input tokens and $10.00 per 1M output tokens through August 31, 2026, with no long-context surcharge
Sonnet 5 uses the updated tokenizer shared with Opus 4.7+ and Fable 5, producing roughly 1.0x to 1.35x as many tokens as Sonnet 4.6 for the same text
Introductory rate of $2.00 input and $10.00 output per 1M tokens made the standard price; the previously scheduled increase to $3.00 and $15.00 was dropped

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.description: First Claude 5 family model: a Mythos-class model made safe for general use with additional safeguards for cyber, bio-chem, and distillation requests

changelog.description: Claude Fable 5 released as a Mythos-class model for general use, alongside Claude Mythos 5 for Project Glasswing partners; 1M context window and up to 128K output tokens
Pricing set at $10.00 per 1M input tokens and $50.00 per 1M output tokens, less than half of Claude Mythos Preview
Access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 was temporarily restricted following a U.S. Department of Commerce export-control directive; Anthropic later confirmed access was restored
Fable 5 became a standard feature of Anthropic's higher-tier subscription plans after several extensions of the launch promotion
Superseded by Claude Fable 5.1 and moved to the legacy model list

models.name: Claude Mythos 5
models.description: Restricted-access version of the Claude 5 Mythos-class model with some safeguards lifted, available to vetted Project Glasswing partners for defensive cybersecurity

changelog.description: Claude Mythos 5 released as a trusted-access preview to a small number of Project Glasswing partners; identical to Fable 5 apart from safeguards
Trusted-access pricing matches Fable 5 at $10.00 per 1M input tokens and $50.00 per 1M output tokens
Claude Mythos 5.1 released as the trusted-access sibling of Fable 5.1 for vetted cyberdefense and life-science organizations
